The evidence provides precise quantitative data (-14.9% vs -2.4%, difference -12.4 percentage points with narrow 95% CI) that directly supports the claim. The randomized controlled trial design justifies causal language. No overclaiming, mechanism-to-evidence leap, or correlation-causation confusion is present. The claim is appropriately scoped to the trial population and duration.
